visual_language.medium: Luminous editorial-diagram illustration: matte fields, precise ink-like lines and geometric marks, soft atmospheric glazing, and isolated forms that can shift between specimen, figure, sign, and abstract relation.
visual_language.surface: A clean matte picture plane with deliberate negative space; paper-like quiet grounds and deep fields both preserve the legibility of lines, seams, rings, labels, gestures, and emitted light.
visual_language.mark_making: Ruled seams, grids, tags, arrows, ripples, wedges, rings, sightlines, and softly glazed human silhouettes; marks behave semantically rather than decoratively.
visual_language.signature_accent: Contained luminescence marks the moment a relation becomes conscious: a warm internal gold, charged coral strike, cool lexical clarity, or amber disclosure is used as a precise semantic accent rather than general glow.
visual_language.finish: Spare philosophical illustration in which a diagram becomes inhabited without losing its conceptual clarity; stylized, tactile, and emotionally legible rather than photorealistic or UI-like.
avoid: busy infographic layouts that require reading labels to understand the image
decorative geometry with no semantic relation
uniform glow that erases the difference between received light and self-originating light
